en: The Hole Argument
zh: 空穴论证 the hole argument (John D. Norton, Oliver Pooley, and James Read)

en: **First published Mon Feb 1, 1999; substantive revision Tue Jun 6, 2023**
zh: *首次发表于 1999 年 2 月 1 日；2023 年 6 月 6 日实质修订。*

en: What is space? What is time? Do they exist independently of the things and processes in them? Or is their existence parasitic on those things and processes? Are they like a canvas onto which an artist paints; they exist whether or not the artist paints on them? Or are they akin to parenthood; there is no parenthood until there are parents and children? That is, is there no space and time until there are things with spatial properties and processes with temporal durations?
zh: 什么是空间？什么是时间？它们独立于其中的事物与过程而存在吗？还是说，它们的存在寄生于那些事物与过程？它们像一块画布吗——无论画家是否作画，画布都在那里？还是说它们更像亲子关系——没有父母与子女，就没有亲缘？也就是说，是不是直到存在具有空间性质的事物、具有时间绵延的过程，才谈得上空间与时间？

en: These questions have long been debated and continue to be debated. The hole argument arose when these questions were asked in the context of modern spacetime physics, and in particular in the context of Einstein’s general theory of relativity. In that context, space and time are fused into a single entity, spacetime, and we inquire into its status. One view is that spacetime is a substance: a thing that exists independently of the processes occurring within it. This is spacetime substantivalism. The hole argument seeks to show that this viewpoint leads to unpalatable conclusions in a large class of spacetime theories. In particular, it seeks to show that spacetime substantivalism leads to a failure of determinism, meaning that a complete specification of the state of the universe at a given time, alongside the laws of nature of the theory under consideration (e.g., the laws of general relativity, which are Einstein’s field equations), fails to determine uniquely how the universe will evolve to the future. It also presents a verificationist dilemma, for it appears to lead to the unexpected conclusion that there are facts about the world which we can never know. Although these problems are neither logically contradictory nor refuted by experience, many would nevertheless regard them as being unpalatable.
zh: 这些问题争论已久，并且至今仍在争论。当人们在现代时空物理学的语境中、尤其是在爱因斯坦广义相对论的语境中追问这些问题时，空穴论证（hole argument）便应运而生。在这个语境里，空间与时间融合为单一的存在者——时空，我们要追问的是它的地位。一种看法认为时空是一种实体：一种独立于其中发生的过程而存在的东西。这就是时空实体论（spacetime substantivalism）。空穴论证试图表明，这一观点在大类时空理论中会导致令人不快的结论。具体而言，它试图表明时空实体论会导致决定论（determinism）的失败，也就是说：给定时刻宇宙状态的完整描述，连同所论理论的自然律（例如广义相对论的定律，即爱因斯坦场方程），并不能唯一地决定宇宙将如何向未来演化。它还提出了一个证实论两难，因为它似乎会引出一个出人意料的结论：世上存在一些我们永远无法知道的事实。这些问题虽然在逻辑上并不自相矛盾，也未经验反驳，但许多人仍会认为它们令人不快。

en: Thereby, the hole argument provides a template for the analysis of what are known as ’gauge redundancies’ in physical theories: i.e., the existence of surplus mathematical structure in such theories. We learn from it that the identification of surplus mathematical structure cannot be achieved by any a priori or purely mathematical rule. Some physical grounds are needed. In line with the above, the hole argument provides two grounds that can be used: (i) verifiability—changes in the candidate surplus structure make no difference to what can be verified in observation; and (ii) determinism—the laws of the theory are unable to fix the candidate surplus structure.
zh: 由此，空穴论证为分析物理理论中所谓的“规范冗余”（gauge redundancies）提供了一个模板：即此类理论中存在多余数学结构的现象。我们从中学到：多余数学结构的认定无法靠任何先验或纯数学的规则达成，而需要某些物理上的依据。与此一致，空穴论证提供了两条可用的依据：（i）可证实性——候选多余结构的变化不会对可被观察证实的东西造成任何差别；（ii）决定论——理论的定律无法固定该候选多余结构。

en: The hole argument was invented for slightly different purposes by Albert Einstein late in 1913 as part of his quest for the general theory of relativity. It was revived and reformulated in the modern context by John³ = John Earman $\times$ John Stachel $\times$ John Norton.
zh: 空穴论证是爱因斯坦于 1913 年末为其广义相对论之探索而发明的，当时的目的与现在略有不同。后来，它在现代语境中由 John³ = John Earman $\times$ John Stachel $\times$ John Norton 复活并重新表述。

en: See Stachel (2014) for a review that covers the historical aspects of the hole argument and its significance in philosophy and physics. It is written at a technically more advanced level than this article. For another recent review of the hole argument, see Pooley (2021).
zh: 关于涵盖空穴论证之历史面向及其在哲学与物理学中之意义的综述，见 Stachel (2014)。该文的技术层次高于本文。另一篇近期的空穴论证综述，见 Pooley (2021)。

en: 1. Modern Spacetime Theories: A Beginner’s Guide
zh: 1 现代时空理论：初学者指南

en: Virtually all modern spacetime theories are now built in the same way. The theory posits a manifold of events and then assigns further structures to those events to represent the content of spacetime. A standard example is Einstein’s general theory of relativity. As a host for the hole argument, we will pursue one of its best known applications, the expanding universes of modern relativistic cosmology.
zh: 如今几乎所有现代时空理论都以同一种方式构建。理论先设定一个事件流形（manifold of events），然后再给这些事件指派进一步的结构，以表现时空的内容。一个标准例子是爱因斯坦的广义相对论。作为空穴论证的宿主，我们将考察它最著名的一个应用：现代相对论宇宙学的膨胀宇宙。

en: This one example illustrates the core content of the hole argument. With only a little further effort, the argument can be made more precise and general. This will be done concurrently in these notes,[^note-1] intended for readers with some background in differential geometry and general relativity.
zh: 这一个例子就展示了空穴论证的核心内容。只需再稍费笔墨，这个论证就可以变得更精确、更一般。我们将在这些脚注中同步完成这一工作，[^note-1] 它们面向具备微分几何与广义相对论背景的读者。

en: Here are the two basic building blocks of modern, relativistic cosmology: a manifold of events and the fields defined on it.
zh: 以下是现代相对论宇宙学的两个基本构件：事件流形，以及定义在它之上的场。

en: **Manifold of Events**. Consider our universe, which relativistic cosmologies attempt to model. Its spacetime is the entirety of all space through all time. The events of this spacetime are generalizations of the dimensionless points of ordinary spatial geometry. A geometric point in ordinary spatial geometry is just a particular spot in the space and has no extension. Correspondingly, an event in spacetime is a particular point in a cosmological space at a particular moment of time.
zh: **事件流形**。考虑我们的宇宙，相对论宇宙学试图为之建立模型。它的时空是纵贯全部时间的全部空间。这个时空中的事件是通常空间几何中无维度点的推广。通常空间几何中的几何点只是空间中的某个特定位置，没有广延。相应地，时空中的事件是宇宙学空间在某个特定时刻的一个特定点。

en: So far, all we have defined is a set of events. To be a four-dimensional manifold, the set of events must be a little bit more organized. In a real spacetime, we have the idea that each event sits in some local neighborhood of events; and this neighborhood sits inside a larger neighborhood of events; and so on. That extra organization comes from the requirement that we can label the events with four numbers—or at least we can do this for any sufficiently small chunk of the manifold. These labels form coordinate systems. The fact that four numbers are just sufficient to label the events makes the manifold four-dimensional. We can now pick out neighborhoods of some event as the set of all points whose spacetime coordinates differ from our starting event by at most one unit; or two units; or three units; etc.. That gives us the nested neighborhoods of events. Figure 1 illustrates how a set of events may be made into a two dimensional manifold by assigning “$x$” and “$y$” coordinates to the events.
zh: 至此我们定义的只是一组事件的集合。要成为一个四维流形，这组事件还须再有一点组织。在真实的时空中，我们的观念是：每个事件都处在某些事件的某个邻域之中；而这个邻域又处在更大的事件邻域之内；如此等等。这份额外的组织来自一个要求：我们能够用四个数来给事件贴标签——或者至少，对流形的任何足够小的区块都能这样做。这些标签构成坐标系。四个数恰好足以给事件贴标签，这一事实使流形成为四维的。我们现在可以挑出某个事件的邻域：取时空坐标与起始事件相差不超过一个单位（或两个、三个单位，等等）的全部点的集合。这就给出了事件的嵌套邻域。图 1 展示了如何通过给事件指派 “$x$” 与 “$y$” 坐标，把一组事件做成二维流形。

en: *Figure 1.*
zh: ![图示：一个小小的、倒置的袋子装有若干以圆点表示的事件，正被倒成一堆，标着“一组事件”；一支标着“用数字平滑地贴标签”的箭头指向圆点被重新铺开到二维网格上的位置，网格由代表笛卡尔坐标常数的横竖直线构成，横线标着 x=0、x=1、x=2、x=3、x=4，竖线标着 y=0、y=1、y=2、y=3、y=4，网格整体标着“事件流形”。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/1.svg) *Figure 1：事件流形的形成。*

en: ![Figure shows a small, upended bag containing events, represented as dots, being emptied into a pile, labeled ‘a set of events’. An arrow labeled ‘Label smoothly with numbers’ points to the site of the dots redistributed over a two-dimensional grid. It has horizontal and vertical straight lines, representing lines of constant Cartesian coordinates. The lines are labeled ‘x=0’, ‘x=1’, ‘x=2’, ‘x=3’ and ‘x=4’; and ‘y=0’, ‘y=1’, ‘y=2’, ‘y=3’ and ‘y=4’. The grid is labeled ‘A manifold of events’.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/1.svg) Figure 1. Forming a manifold of events
zh: **度规结构与物质场**。规定了事件构成四维流形之后，关于这些事件我们仍有*大量*未曾说出的东西。我们没有规定哪些事件处于另一些事件的未来与过去，这些事件之间流逝了多少时间，哪些事件彼此同时从而能构成三维空间，哪些空间距离分隔开这些事件，以及更多相关的性质。

en: **Metrical Structure and Matter Fields**. In specifying that events form a four dimensional manifold, there is still a lot we have *not* said about the events. We have not specified which events lie in the future and past of which other events, how much time elapses between these events, which events are simultaneous with others so that they can form three dimensional spaces, what spatial distances separates these events, and many more related properties.
zh: 这些额外的性质通过规定度规场（metric field）引入。要看这个场如何提供这些信息，请想象一条连接时空一对事件的曲线。流逝的时间与空间距离的信息，就由沿这类曲线度量的时间与距离给出。见图 2：

en: These additional properties are introduced by specifying the metric field. To see how this field provides that information, imagine a curve connecting a given pairs of events in spacetime. The information about times elapsed and spatial distances is given by the times elapsed and distances along such curves. See Figure 2:
zh: ![图示：一个矩形标着“事件流形”，事件以圆点表示；一个向上的箭头标着“时间”，表示时间沿竖直方向推进，一个双向横向箭头标着“空间”，表示空间横向铺开；一个等时面侧视为平行四边形，其上两点由一条线相连；面标注“同一时刻的事件在流形中构成一个曲面，它是某一时刻空间的快照”以及“度规沿空间中连接同时事件的曲线度量距离”；一条竖线连接标着“较早”与“较晚”的两个事件（圆点），线标注“度规沿较早事件与较晚事件之间的世界线度量流逝的时间”。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/2.svg) *Figure 2：度规场的功能。*

en: *Figure 2.*
zh: 这些信息本可以由一份巨大的目录来提供，它逐一给出沿连接曲线度量的每一对事件之间的空间或时间距离。但这份目录会是大量冗余的：如果我们知道沿某条曲线从 $A$ 到 $B$ 以及从 $B$ 到 $C$ 的距离，那么沿同一条曲线从 $A$ 到 $C$ 的距离也就知道了。我们需要的最少信息，是每个事件与所有（粗略地说）与它无穷接近的事件之间的时间与空间距离。度规场提供的就是这份信息。它之所以是一个“场”，是因为这份信息只属于单个事件。我们随后只需把曲线上相继的无穷接近点之间的距离逐一加总，就能拼出沿任何曲线的时间与空间距离。

en: ![A rectangle is labeled ‘a manifold of events’. The events are shown as dots. An up arrow labeled ‘time’ indicate that time is represented as advancing in the up-vertical direction and a two-headed horizontal arrow labeled ‘space’ indicates that space is spread across horizontally. A constant time surface, seen side on as a parallelogram, has two points representing events connected by a line. The surface is labeled ‘Events at the same time form a surface in the manifold that is a snapshot of space at one instant’. and ‘Metric measures distance along curves in space that connect events at the same time’. A vertical line connects two events, represented as dots, labeled ‘earlier’ and ‘later’. The line is labeled ‘Metric measures time elapsed along worldliness between earlier and later events’.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/2.svg) Figure 2. The function of the metric field.
zh: 宇宙的物质由物质场（matter fields）表示。最简单的物质——构成星系的大块——可以由世界线（worldlines）表示，每条世界线描绘一个星系贯穿时间的全部历史。在标准模型中，星系彼此退行，这由星系世界线在走向更晚时刻时彼此散开来表示。见图 3：

en: That information could be supplied by a huge catalog that specifies the spatial or temporal distance between pairs of events along curves connecting them. Such a huge catalog would be massively redundant, however. If we know the distance from $A$ to $B$ and from $B$ to $C$ along some curve, then we know the distance from $A$ to $C$ along that curve as well. The minimum information we need is the temporal and spatial distance between each event and all those (loosely speaking) infinitesimally close to it. That information is what the metric field provides. It is a “field” since that information belongs just to one event. We can then piece together temporal and spatial distance along any curve just by summing all the distances between successive infinitesimally close points along the curve.
zh: ![图示：矩形中一个向上的箭头标着“时间”，表示时间沿竖直方向推进，双向横向箭头标着“空间”；一个时刻的空间侧视为平行四边形，其上排布着五个星系的微型草图；五条近乎竖直的线穿过星系，随图形向上推进而彼此散开，标着“星系的世界线”。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/3.svg) *Figure 3：膨胀宇宙中的星系。*

en: The matter of the universe is represented by matter fields. The simplest form of matter—the big lumps that make galaxies—can be represented by worldlines that trace out the history of each galaxy through time. In standard models, the galaxies recede from one another and this is represented by a spreading apart of the galactic worldlines as we proceed to later times. See Figure 3:
zh: 2 广义协变性的自由

en: *Figure 3.*
zh: 牛顿第一定律说，不受力的物体沿直线轨迹穿过时空。显然，这条定律如其所述不可能在所有坐标系中都成立：设想一个相对于该定律成立的坐标系作加速运动的坐标系，在加速坐标系中，不受力的物体也会显得在加速！所以牛顿第一定律——借用爱因斯坦在 1910 年代探索广义相对论时引入的一个术语——不是“广义协变的”（generally covariant）。当爱因斯坦在 1915 年最终完成广义相对论时，它的新颖特征之一就是广义协变性（general covariance）：与上面表述的牛顿第一定律不同，广义相对论的爱因斯坦场方程若在某个坐标系中成立，则在所有与该坐标系经平滑但任意的变换相联系的坐标系中都成立。广义相对论的确是第一个允许以这种方式自由使用任意时空坐标系的时空理论。如今几乎所有现代时空理论的表述都共享这一特征，包括狭义相对论的现代版本，以及（也许令人意外！）牛顿时空理论（关于后者，见如 Friedman (1983)）。

en: ![In a rectangle, an up arrow labeled ‘time’ indicate that time is represented as advancing in the up-vertical direction and a two-headed horizontal arrow labeled ‘space’ indicates that space is spread across horizontally. An instant of space is seen side on as a parallelogram. Tiny sketches of five galaxies are laid out across the parallelogram. Five nearly vertical lines are drawn through the galaxies such that they spread apart as they proceed up the figure. They are labeled ‘Worldlines of galaxies’.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/3.svg) Figure 3. Galaxies in an expanding universe.
zh: 在其原初形态中，广义协变性被“被动地”（passively）理解：即描述时空中的结构时，可以任意选取坐标系。这一自由与另一个自由密切相关，即“主动的”（active）广义协变性。按照主动广义协变性，我们可以把度规场之类的结构以与坐标变换同样多的不同方式铺展到流形上，而这些场在流形上重新分布的结果将保持所论理论的解的地位。被动广义协变性与如此定义的主动广义协变性并不等价，因为一个理论可以在被动意义上广义协变，而场在流形上的任意平滑重新分布一般并不保持解的地位：细节在此并不重要，进一步讨论见 Pooley (2017)。（关于主动与被动协变性关系的更详尽说明，另见补充材料[主动与被动协变性](spacetime-holearg.active-passive.md)。）[^note-2] 重要的是，每一种“局域”时空理论（借用 Earman & Norton (1987) 的术语）都是主动广义协变的，因而都会遭遇某种版本的空穴论证——这包括狭义相对论以及牛顿力学的某些表述。（有一种看法认为这走得太远了，认为广义相对论区别于许多其他时空理论之处在于其时空几何已经变成动力学的，并且只有在这类理论中才应当发动空穴论证：进一步讨论见 Earman (1989, Ch.9, Section 5)、Stachel (1993) 与 Iftime and Stachel (2006)。）

en: 2. The Freedom of General Covariance
zh: 下文中我们将聚焦于主动广义协变性，它确为广义相对论（以及其他局域时空理论）所具有的性质。空穴论证的关键操作正是行使这一自由。图 4 展示了把度规结构与物质场铺展到时空事件流形上的一种可能方式：

en: Newton’s first law states that force-free bodies move on straight-line trajectories through spacetime. Clearly, this law as stated cannot be true in all coordinate systems, for imagine such a system accelerating with respect to one in which the law holds true: in the accelerating coordinate system, the force-free bodies will also appear to accelerate! So Newton’s first law is not—to use a piece of terminology introduced by Einstein in his quest for the general theory of relativity in the 1910s—‘generally covariant’. When Einstein finally arrived at his completed theory of general relativity in 1915, one of its novel features was its general covariance: unlike Newton’s first law in its formulation above, if the Einstein field equations of general relativity hold in one coordinate system, then they hold true in all coordinate systems related to that original system by smooth but otherwise arbitrary transformations. General relativity was, indeed, the first spacetime theory in which one was free to use arbitrary spacetime coordinate systems in this way. This feature is now shared by virtually all modern formulations of spacetime theories, including modern versions of special relativity and (perhaps surprisingly!) Newtonian spacetime theory (on the latter, see e.g. Friedman (1983)).
zh: ![图示：一张上缘翻折的矩形纸片上画着图 3 的星系膨胀系统，两个空间曲面由竖线相连，纸片标注“度规与物质场”；箭头表示这张纸片要叠放到第二个矩形上，第二个矩形标着“流形”，其中一些事件以圆点表示；图中还画了一张同样的纸片叠放在流形上。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/4.svg) *Figure 4：把度规与物质铺展到流形上的一种方式。*

en: In its original form, general covariance was understood “passively”; that is, as a freedom to describe structures in spacetime by means of arbitrarily chosen coordinate systems. That freedom is closely related to another freedom, known as “active” general covariance. According to active general covariance, we are licensed to spread structures like metric fields over the manifold in as many different ways as there are coordinate transformations, and the resulting redistributions of said fields on the manifold will preserve solutionhood of the theory under consideration. Passive general covariance is not equivalent to active general covariance defined in this way, for a theory can be passively generally covariant and yet arbitrary smooth redistributions of the fields on the manifold will in general fail to preserve solutionhood: the details are not important here, but see Pooley (2017) for further discussion. (For a more extensive account of the relationship between active and passive covariance, see also the supplementary document: [Active and Passive Covariance](spacetime-holearg.active-passive.md).)[^note-2] What is important is that every ‘local’ spacetime theory (to use terminology of Earman & Norton (1987)) is actively generally covariant, and so will be subject to a version of the hole argument—this includes both special relativity and certain formulations of Newtonian mechanics. (One view is that this goes too far, and that general relativity is distinct from many other spacetime theories in that its spacetime geometry has become dynamical and it is only in such theories that the hole argument should be mounted: for further discussion, see Earman (1989, Ch.9, Section 5), Stachel (1993), and Iftime and Stachel (2006).)
zh: 图 5 展示了第二种方式：

en: In what follows, we’ll focus on active general covariance, which is indeed a property possessed by general relativity (as well as other local spacetime theories). The essential manipulation of the hole argument involves exercising this freedom. Figure 4 illustrates one way that we might spread the metrical structure and matter fields over the manifold of spacetime events:
zh: ![图示：本图与前一张图 4 相同，仅有一处改动：在叠放到流形上的纸片中央有一个虚线椭圆，标着“空洞”（THE HOLE）；椭圆内部的空间曲面与竖线略微向右上方移位，同时在椭圆边缘处仍与图形未改动部分平滑相连。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/5.svg) *Figure 5：把度规与物质铺展到流形上的另一种方式。*

en: *Figure 4.*
zh: 我们把这两种铺展之间的变换称为“洞变换”（hole transformation）。虚线区域就是空洞（The Hole）。度规场与物质场的第一次分布在被变换为第二次时：

en: ![In a rectangular sheet with overturned top edge, the expanding system of galaxies of Figure 3 is shown with two spatial surfaces connected by vertical lines. It is labeled ‘Metric and matter fields’. Arrows indicate that the sheet is to be superimposed on a second rectangle, labeled ‘manifold’, in which some events are represented as dots. A duplicate of the rectangular sheet is shown superimposed on the manifold.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/4.svg) Figure 4. One way to spread metric and matter over the manifold.
zh: - 在空洞之外，场保持不变； - 在空洞之内，场被铺展得不同； - 而洞内外的铺展平滑衔接。[^note-3]

en: Figure 5 illustrates a second way:
zh: 重要的是，图 5 中变换前后的两个状态都是广义相对论爱因斯坦场方程的解——这意味着，按照该理论，它们都代表世界可能的存在方式。

en: *Figure 5.*
zh: 3 不变量的保持

en: ![The figure is a duplication of the previous Figure 4 with one change. In the center of the sheet superimposed on the manifold is a dotted ellipse, labeled ‘THE HOLE’. Inside the ellipse the spatial surface and vertical lines are displaced slightly up and to the right, while still connecting smoothly to the other parts of the unaltered figure at the edge of the ellipse.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/5.svg) Figure 5. Another way to spread metric and matter over the manifold.
zh: 3.1 不变量

en: We shall call the transformation between the two spreadings a “hole transformation.” The dotted region is The Hole. The first distribution of metric and matter fields is transformed into the second in a way that
zh: 两种不同的铺展共享一个至关重要的特征，空穴论证正依赖于此：两种铺展在所有不变性质上完全一致。

en: - leaves the fields unchanged outside the hole; - within the hole they are spread differently; - and the spreadings inside and outside the hole join smoothly.[^note-3]
zh: 粗略地说，这些不变性质是几何与动力学所固有的性质，例如沿空间曲线的距离、沿星系世界线的时间、星系的静止质量、其中的粒子数，以及一大类其他性质，例如时空在度规上是平直还是弯曲。

en: Importantly, both the pre- and post-transformed states in Figure 5 are solutions of Einstein’s field equations of general relativity—meaning that they both represent possible ways for the world to be, according to the theory.
zh: 不变性质与非不变性质相互区别。最有名的非不变性质是依赖于坐标系选取的那些性质。例如，在二维欧氏空间中恰好只有一个事件位于坐标系的原点，即 $x=0,$ $y=0$。但当我们改变坐标系时，是哪一个事件位于原点也随之改变。所以“位于原点”不是不变量。而两点之间的空间距离无论用什么坐标系来描述都相同。它是不变量。

en: 3. The Preservation of Invariants
zh: 虽然场在两种情形下铺展不同，但它们在所有不变性质上一致；所以，用不变量的语言说，它们是相同的。

en: 3.1 Invariants
zh: 3.2 不变量与可观测量

en: The two different spreadings share one vital characteristic upon which the hole argument depends: the two spreadings agree completely on all invariant properties.
zh: 时空理论的不变量与其可观测量（observables，即可以被观察证实的那些量）之间有一种特殊关系：

en: These invariant properties are, loosely speaking, the ones that are intrinsic to the geometry and dynamics, such as distance along spatial curves and time along worldlines of galaxies, the rest mass of the galaxy, the number of particles in it, as well as a host of other properties, such as whether the spacetimes are metrically flat or curved.
zh: 一切可观测量都可以还原为不变量。

en: The invariant properties are distinguished from non-invariant properties. Best known of the non-invariant properties are those dependent on a particular choice of coordinate system. For example, just one event in a two-dimensional Euclidean space lies at the origin of a coordinate system, that is, at $x=0,$ $y=0$. But which event that is changes when we change our coordinate system. So “being at the origin” is not an invariant. The spatial distance between two points, however, is that same no matter which coordinate system is used to describe the space. It is an invariant.
zh: 例如，若某人从星系 A 旅行到星系 B，与这段旅程相关的所有可观测量都将是不变量。它们包括旅程中流逝的时间、飞船在旅程中任一时刻是否在加速、出发时所在星系与抵达时所在星系的年龄，以及一切可能涉及以粒子或光脉冲发送信号的操作。

en: While the fields are spread differently in the two cases, they agree in all invariant properties; so, in invariant terms, they are the same.
zh: 因此，既然洞变换的两种度规与物质场的铺展（分布）在不变量上一致，它们也就在一切可观测量上一致。它们在观察上不可区分。

en: 3.2 Invariants and Observables
zh: 4 什么代表时空？

en: There is a special relationship between the invariants of a spacetime theory and its observables, i.e. those quantities which are accessible to observational verification:
zh: 回想我们最初的关切：我们想知道，能否把时空设想为一种实体——即某种独立于在它之中展开的物质事件而存在的东西。为此，我们需要知道，在上述结构中是什么代表着时空。对这个问题的一种流行回答是：事件流形代表时空。这个选择很自然，因为现代时空理论正是先设定事件流形、再在其上定义进一步的结构而构建起来的。于是，在一种把物理理论“按字面”理解的实在论观点下，把流形视为一种独立存在的、承载性质的、从而扮演容器的结构——正如我们期望时空所扮演的那样——是非常自然的。[^note-4]

en: All observables can be reduced to invariants.
zh: 有人可能想知道：流形上定义的某些进一步结构，是否代表时空的进一步性质，而非时空之内的内容物。特别是，度规场包含关于空间距离与时间流逝的重要信息。它难道不该也被视为承载时空的一部分，而非时空之内的内容物吗？

en: For example, if one makes a journey from one galaxy to another, all observables pertinent to the trip will be invariants. These include the time elapsed along the journey, whether the spaceship is accelerating or not at any time in its journey, the age of the galaxy one leaves at the start of the trip and the age of the destination galaxy at the end and all operations that may involve signaling with particles or light pulses.
zh: 针对这条思路，有人会反驳说：广义相对论使得人们很难把度规场单纯看作承载时空的一部分。因为除空间与时间信息之外，度规场还代表引力场，因此它也携带能量与动量——引力场的能量与动量（尽管广义相对论中一个臭名昭著的技术难题使得人们无法在时空的任何特定事件处认定引力场的能量与动量*密度*）。这些能量与动量在时空中与其他物质场自由交换。携带能量与动量（照这种想法）正是时空之内所容物质的一个自然的区分性特征。

en: Therefore, since the two spreadings or distributions of metric and matter fields of a hole transformation agree on invariants, they also agree on all observables. They are observationally indistinguishable.
zh: 所以，广义相对论的度规场似乎难以简单定性。我们希望它要么专属作为容器的时空，要么专属作为内容物的物质；可它似乎两者都沾。但无论如何，这里的关键（与关于空穴论证的某些历史论著相反）在于：要发动空穴论证，根本不必先了结这个问题！只要你处理的理论在上文阐明的意义上是主动广义协变的，空穴论证就会冒出头来，下面我们就会看到。

en: 4. What Represents Spacetime?
zh: 5 时空实体论的代价

en: Recall our original concern: we want to know whether we can conceive of spacetime as a substance—that is, as something that exists independently of the material events which unfold within it. To do this, we need to know what in the above structures represents spacetime. One popular answer to that question is that the manifold of events represents spacetime. This choice is natural since modern spacetime theories are built up by first positing a manifold of events and then defining further structures on them. So, on a realist view of physical theories on which they are to be understood ‘literally’, it is very natural to regard the manifold as being an independently existing structure that bears properties, and which thereby plays the role of a container just as we expect that spacetime does.[^note-4]
zh: 到目前为止，我们把实体论学说刻画为“时空拥有独立于其内容的存在”这一观点。这种表述唤起了有力却含混的直观图景，但它不够清晰，难以用在物理理论的解释事业中。如果我们用一个事件流形来表示时空，如何刻画其存在的独立性？它是不是这样一个反事实主张：倘若没有度规场与物质场，事件流形依然存在？标准表述设定一切时空至少具有度规结构，这一反事实便被它自动否定了。这似乎是对流形实体论过于廉价的反驳。想必应当有一个改进的表述。幸运的是，我们无需为找到它而绞尽脑汁。就眼下目的而言，我们只需考察实体论观点的一个后果，而把精确表述该观点的任务放到一边。

en: One might wonder whether some of the further structures defined on the manifold represent further properties of spacetime rather than what is contained within spacetime. In particular, the metric field contains important information on spatial distances and times elapsed. Ought that not also to be considered a part of the containing spacetime as opposed to what is contained within spacetime?
zh: 在莱布尼茨与克拉克那场关于空间与时间的著名论战中，莱布尼茨讥讽实体论者牛顿的代言人克拉克（Clarke）：如果把东与西对调，世界会有什么变化？对莱布尼茨来说没有任何变化，因为物体之间的一切空间关系都会被这种对调保持。但牛顿式实体论者不得不承认，世界上的物体如今位于不同的空间位置，因此两个系统在物理上是不同的。

en: Against this line of thought, some would argue that general relativity makes it hard to view the metric field simply as being part of the containing spacetime. For, in addition to spatial and temporal information, the metric field also represents the gravitational field. Therefore it also carries energy and momentum—the energy and momentum of the gravitational field (although a notorious technical problem in general relativity precludes identifying the energy and momentum *density* of the gravitational field at any particular event in spacetime). This energy and momentum is freely interchanged with other matter fields in spacetimes. To carry energy and momentum is (the thought goes) a natural distinguishing characteristic of matter contained within spacetime.
zh: 相应地，当我们把度规场与物质场以不同方式铺展到事件流形上时，我们就是在以不同的方式把度规性质与物质性质指派给流形的事件。例如，设想一个星系穿过空洞中的某个事件 E。经过洞变换之后，这个星系可能不再穿过那个事件。对流形实体论者而言，这必须是客观的物理事实：星系要么穿过 E，要么不穿过。两种分布代表两种物理上不同的可能性。

en: So, the metric field of general relativity seems to defy easy characterization. We would like it to be exclusively part of spacetime the container, or exclusively part of matter the contained. Yet it seems to be part of both. But in any case, the crucial point to note here (contrary to some historical writing on the hole argument) is that one need not settle this issue in order to get the hole argument off the ground! As long as one is dealing with a theory which is actively generally covariant in the sense articulated above, the hole argument will rear its head, as we will now see.
zh: ![图示：图 4 那张矩形纸片的两份拷贝，两者都画着标有“空洞”（THE HOLE）的椭圆。第一份中，椭圆内中央竖线上的一个圆点标着 E；第二份中画出了图 5 在椭圆内的形变。标着 E 的圆点留在原位，于是那条竖线不再穿过它。](../yuanwen/assets/spacetime-holearg/6.svg) *Figure 6：星系是否穿过事件 $E$？*

en: 5. The Price of Spacetime Substantivalism
zh: 也就是说，流形实体论者必须（看起来）否定一个由莱布尼茨的讥讽所启发、并以其命名的等价：[^note-5]

en: So far we have characterized the substantivalist doctrine as the view that spacetime has an existence independent of its contents. This formulation conjures up powerful if vague intuitive pictures, but it is not clear enough to be deployed in the context of the interpretation of physical theories. If we represent spacetime by a manifold of events, how do we characterize the independence of its existence? Is it the counterfactual claim that were there no metric or matter fields, there would still be a manifold of events? That counterfactual is automatically denied by the standard formulation which posits that all spacetimes have at least metrical structure. That seems too cheap a refutation of manifold substantivalism. Surely, there must be an improved formulation. Fortunately, we do not need to wrestle with finding it. For present purposes we need only consider a consequence of the substantivalist view and can set aside the task of giving a precise formulation of that view.
zh: **莱布尼茨等价（Leibniz Equivalence）**。若两个场的分布经一个平滑变换相联系，则它们代表同一个物理系统。

en: In their celebrated debate over space and time, Leibniz taunted the substantivalist Newton’s representative, Clarke, by asking how the world would change if East and West were switched. For Leibniz there would be no change since all spatial relations between bodies would be preserved by such a switch. But the Newtonian substantivalist had to concede that the bodies of the world were now located in different spatial positions, so the two systems were physically distinct.
zh: 补充材料[通过地图投影直观理解莱布尼茨等价](spacetime-holearg.leibniz-equivalence.md)借助地球表面不同地图投影的类比，阐发了莱布尼茨等价的核心观念。

en: Correspondingly, when we spread the metric and matter fields differently over a manifold of events, we are now assigning metrical and material properties in different ways to the events of the manifold. For example, imagine that a galaxy passes through some event E in the hole. After the hole transformation, this galaxy might not pass through that event. For the manifold substantivalist, this must be a matter of objective physical fact: either the galaxy passes through E or not. The two distributions represent two physically distinct possibilities.
zh: 6 不快的后果

en: *Figure 6.*
zh: 现在我们可以把上面的部件拼装起来，为流形实体论者制造不快的后果。考虑经洞变换相联系的两种度规场与物质场分布。由于流形实体论者否定莱布尼茨等价，实体论者必须主张这两个系统代表不同的物理系统。但区分二者的性质极为难以捉摸：它们既逃过（a）观察证实，也逃过（b）宇宙学理论的决定能力。

en: ![The figure shows two copies of the rectangular sheet of Figure 4 with the ellipse labeled ‘THE HOLE’ shown on both. In the first, a dot on the central vertical line within the ellipse is labeled ‘E’. In the second copy, the distortions of Figure 5 within the ellipse are shown. The dot labeled E is in its original position, so that the vertical line no longer passes through it.](../assets/spacetime-holearg/6.svg) Figure 6. Does the galaxy pass through event $E$?
zh: （a）*观察证实*。实体论者必须坚持：星系是否穿过事件 $E$ 会造成物理差别。但我们已经注意到，两种分布在观察上等价：任何观察都无法告诉我们，我们是身处星系穿过事件 $E$ 的世界，还是错过事件 $E$ 的世界。

en: That is, manifold substantivalists must (it seems) deny an equivalence inspired by Leibniz’ taunt which is thus named after him:[^note-5]
zh: 从图 6 可能不太容易看出两种分布在观察上等价。左边的第一种分布中，中间的星系沿一条看似直线的路径运动，并且恰好保持在两侧星系的空间中点上。右边的第二种分布中，这一切似乎都被破坏了：星系看起来在向右急转时加速，从而更靠近它右侧的星系。

en: **Leibniz Equivalence**. If two distributions of fields are related by a smooth transformation, then they represent the same physical systems.
zh: 图 6 的呈现所显示的这些差别全都是非不变量的差别。对右边的分布而言，星系在图中确实向右偏转，但与此同时，事件之间的距离也被拉长了，正如补充材料[通过地图投影直观理解莱布尼茨等价](spacetime-holearg.leibniz-equivalence.md)中各种地图投影里距离被拉长一样。所以星系始终保持在两侧星系的空间中点上；只是从图形的画法上看不像是这样。

en: The supplementary document [Visualizing Leibniz Equivalence Through Map Projections](spacetime-holearg.leibniz-equivalence.md) illustrates the essential idea of Leibniz Equivalence through an analogy with different map projections of the Earth’s surface.
zh: 类似地，沿星系世界线的一个加速度矢量决定星系是否在加速。这个加速度矢量是不变量。所以，如果左边分布中的星系加速度矢量为零，那么右边分布中对应的星系加速度矢量也为零。记住：洞变换保持不变量。所以若星系在左边分布中不受加速，它在右边分布中也不受加速。

en: 6. Unhappy Consequences
zh: （b）*决定论*。相对论宇宙学的物理理论无法在两种情形之间做出选择。这表现为理论的一种非决定论（indeterminism）。我们可以规定整个事件流形上度规场与物质场的分布，唯独在标示为空洞的区域之内除外。然后，理论无法告诉我们场在空洞之内将如何发展。原有分布与变换后的分布都是洞外度规场与物质场向空洞之内的合法延拓，因为二者都满足相对论宇宙学理论的全部定律。理论没有任何资源能让我们坚持其中只有一个是可取的。

en: We can now assemble the pieces above to generate unhappy consequences for the manifold substantivalist. Consider the two distributions of metric and material fields related by a hole transformation. Since the manifold substantivalist denies Leibniz Equivalence, the substantivalist must hold that the two systems represent distinct physical systems. But the properties that distinguish the two are very elusive. They escape both (a) observational verification and (b) the determining power of cosmological theory.
zh: 必须看到，这个不快的后果并不只在于决定论的失败。我们对这类失败再熟悉不过了，它当然不足以自动否证一个物理理论。最著名的、广受赞誉的非决定论理论的例子是量子理论：在标准诠释中，对系统的测量可以导致向多个可能结果之一的不确定性坍缩。鲜为人知的是，在经典物理中同样可以构造非决定论系统。多数例子涉及一些古怪情形，例如物体以无界速度从空间无穷远处凭空出现，即所谓“太空入侵者”（Earman 1986a, 第三章；另见词条“因果决定论”）。它们也可能由超任务（Supertasks）中无穷多物体的相互作用产生。更晚近，出现了一个极其简单的例子：单个质块停在一个穹顶顶端，在任意的延时之后、沿任意方向自发地开始运动（Norton 2003, Section 3）。

en: (a) *Observational verification*. The substantivalist must insist that it makes a physical difference whether the galaxy passes through event $E$ or not. But we have already noticed that the two distributions are observationally equivalent: no observation can tell us if we are in a world in which the galaxy passes through event $E$ or misses event $E$.
zh: 空穴论证中决定论失败的问题不在于失败这一事实，而在于它失败的方式。如果我们否定流形实体论并接受莱布尼茨等价，那么由洞变换诱导的非决定论就被根除了。尽管向洞内延拓的场在数学上有不可数多种互不相同的方式，但在莱布尼茨等价之下，它们在物理上全部相同。也就是说，物理场向洞内的延拓终究是唯一的。于是，这种非决定论是实体论者形而上学承诺的直接后果。类似地，如果我们接受莱布尼茨等价，我们也就不再为两种分布无法被任何可能的观察区分而困扰：它们只是同一物理实在的不同数学描述，因而理应在一切可观测量上一致。

en: It might be a little hard to see from Figure 6 that the two distributions are observationally equivalent. In the first distribution on the left, the middle galaxy moves in what looks like a straight line and stays exactly at the spatial midpoint between the galaxies on either side. In the second distribution on the right, all that seems to be undone. The galaxy looks like it accelerates in taking a swerve to the right, so that it moves closer to the galaxy on its right.
zh: 所以，空穴论证所邀请的反实体论结论是：我们可以往任何物理理论里塞进无法被观察固定的对象或性质（此处即时空事件）。如果它们对观察的不可见性尚不足以作为它们不合法的警示，那么发现它们把非决定论带给一个原本决定论的理论，理应足以作为警示。因此，这样的对象或性质（此处即时空事件）应当连同任何要求保留它们的学说一道被抛弃。

en: These differences that show up in the portrayal of Figure 6 are all non-invariant differences. For the right hand distribution, the galaxy does veer to the right in the figure, but at the same time, distances between events get stretched as well, just as they get stretched in the various map projections shown in the supplement, [Visualizing Leibniz Equivalence Through Map Projections](spacetime-holearg.leibniz_equivalence.md). So the galaxy always remains at the spatial midpoint of the galaxies on either side; it just doesn’t look like it is at the spatial midpoint from the way the figure is drawn.
zh: 7 空穴论证概要

en: Similarly, an acceleration vector along the galaxy’s worldline determines whether the galaxy is accelerating. That acceleration vector is an invariant. So, if the galaxy in the left hand distribution has a zero acceleration vector, then the corresponding galaxy in the right hand distribution will also have a zero acceleration vector. Remember, a hole transformation preserves invariants. So if a galaxy is unaccelerated in the left hand distribution, it is also unaccelerated in the right hand distribution.
zh: 概括起来，空穴论证等于下述内容：[^note-6]

en: (b) *Determinism*. The physical theory of relativistic cosmology is unable to pick between the two cases. This is manifested as an indeterminism of the theory. We can specify the distribution of metric and material fields throughout the manifold of events, excepting within the region designated as The Hole. Then the theory is unable to tell us how the fields will develop into The Hole. Both the original and the transformed distribution are legitimate extensions of the metric and matter fields outside The Hole into The Hole, since each satisfies all the laws of the theory of relativistic cosmology. The theory has no resources which allow us to insist that one only is admissible.
zh: 若两个度规场与物质场的分布经洞变换相联系，则流形实体论者必须主张这两个系统代表两个不同的物理系统（即他们必须否定莱布尼茨等价）。 这种物理上的区别度超越观察与理论的决定能力，因为： 两种分布在观察上同一。 理论的定律无法在两种向洞内的场延拓之间做出选择。 因此，流形实体论者倡导了一种成问题的形而上学，应当予以抛弃。

en: It is important to see that the unhappy consequence does not consist merely of a failure of determinism. We are all too familiar with such failures and it is certainly not automatic grounds for dismissal of a physical theory. The best known instance of a widely celebrated, indeterministic theory is quantum theory, where, in the standard interpretation, the measurement of a system can lead to an indeterministic collapse onto one of many possible outcomes. Less well known is that it is possible to devise indeterministic systems in classical physics as well. Most examples involves oddities such as bodies materializing at unbounded speed from spatial infinity, so called “space invaders.” (Earman, 1986a, Ch. III; see also determinism: causal) Or they may arise through the interaction of infinitely many bodies in a supertask (Supertasks). More recently, an extremely simple example has emerged in which a single mass sits atop a dome and spontaneously sets itself into motion after an arbitrary time delay and in an arbitrary direction (Norton, 2003, Section 3).
zh: 8 空穴论证的历史

en: The problem with the failure of determinism in the hole argument is not the fact of failure but the way that it fails. If we deny manifold substantivalism and accept Leibniz Equivalence, then the indeterminism induced by a hole transformation is eradicated. While there are uncountably many mathematically distinct developments of the fields into the hole, under Leibniz Equivalence, they are all physically the same. That is, there is a unique development of the physical fields into the hole after all. Thus the indeterminism is a direct consequence of the substantivalist’s metaphysical commitments. Similarly, if we accept Leibniz Equivalence, then we are no longer troubled that the two distributions cannot be distinguished by any possible observation. They are merely different mathematical descriptions of the same physical reality and so should agree on all observables.
zh: 8.1 爱因斯坦落入空洞……

en: So, the anti-substantivalist conclusion invited by the hole argument is this. We can load up any physical theory with objects or properties (here: spacetime events) that cannot be fixed by observation. If their invisibility to observation is not already sufficient warning that these properties are illegitimate, then finding that they visit indeterminism onto a theory that is otherwise deterministic ought to be warning enough. Therefore, such objects or properties (again, here spacetime events) should be discarded along with any doctrine that requires their retention.
zh: 空穴论证是爱因斯坦在 1913 年末发明的，是一种绝望之举：当时他为广义相对论的探索遭遇了看似不可逾越的障碍。此前一年，他立志寻找一个在上文意义上广义协变的引力理论。他甚至已经考虑过本质上正是他 1915 年 11 月最终敲定、如今出现在所有教科书中的那些广义协变方程。

en: 7. The Hole Argument in Brief
zh: 不幸的是，爱因斯坦至少起初没能看出这些方程是可取的。牛顿引力理论在弱引力场中近乎完美地成立。所以爱因斯坦的理论在这个情形下必须退回牛顿理论，这一点至关重要。但无论怎么努力，爱因斯坦都没能看出他的方程及其许多变体能与牛顿理论恰当衔接。1913 年年中，他发表了一个折中方案：一个非广义协变的相对论引力理论纲要。（关于这些挣扎的更多细节，见 Norton (1984)。）

en: In sum, the hole argument amounts to this:[^note-6]
zh: 找不到可取的广义协变理论，令爱因斯坦深感困扰。1913 年晚些时候，他试图把失败转化为某种胜利：他以为自己能够表明，任何广义协变理论都不可取。任何这类理论都会违反他所称的“因果律”（Law of Causality）——我们如今称之为决定论。他试图用空穴论证来证明这个惊人的主张。

en: If one has two distributions of metric and material fields related by a hole transformation, then manifold substantivalists must maintain that the two systems represent two distinct physical systems (i.e., they must deny Leibniz Equivalence). This physical distinctness transcends both observation and the determining power of the theory since: The two distributions are observationally identical. The laws of the theory cannot pick between the two developments of the fields into the hole. Therefore, the manifold substantivalist advocates a problematic metaphysics which should be discarded.
zh: 在其最初形态中，爱因斯坦考虑一个充满物质的时空，唯独一个区域——空洞——没有物质。（所以在原初形态里，“洞”一词比在现代版本中更贴切。）然后他问：洞外度规场与物质场的完整规定能否固定洞内的度规场。由于他默认了抛弃莱布尼茨等价，爱因斯坦认为这个否定的答案足以给一切广义协变理论定罪。

en: 8. The History of the Hole Argument
zh: 8.2 ……又爬了出来

en: 8.1 Einstein Falls into the Hole…
zh: 爱因斯坦带着他那个协变性受限的畸形理论又挣扎了两年。1915 年末，随着他的错误的证据不可阻挡地累积，爱因斯坦被逼到近乎绝望、最终屈服的境地。他带着新的紧迫感回到寻找广义协变方程的工作，这部分地出于一个认识：堂堂大卫·希尔伯特（David Hilbert）已经亲自投入对他理论的分析。1915 年 11 月末，爱因斯坦的探索以广义协变形式的理论完成而圆满落幕。

en: The hole argument was created by Albert Einstein late in 1913 as an act of desperation when his quest for his general theory of relativity had encountered what appeared to be insuperable obstacles. Over the previous year, he had been determined to find a gravitation theory that was generally covariant in the sense introduced above. He had even considered essentially the celebrated generally covariant equations he would settle upon in November 1915 and which now appear in all the textbooks.
zh: 很长时间里，人们认为希尔伯特比爱因斯坦早五天得到了最终理论。希尔伯特论文校样形式的新证据现在表明，事情可能并非如此。更重要的是，证据清楚地表明，希尔伯特与爱因斯坦一样，至少曾一度相信空穴论证排斥一切广义协变理论，而且这一信念至少保持到其论文校样之时。（见 Corry, Renn and Stachel 1997。）

en: Unfortunately, Einstein had at least initially been unable to see that these equations were admissible. Newton’s theory of gravitation worked virtually perfectly for weak gravitational fields. So it was essential that Einstein’s theory revert to Newton’s in that case. But try as he might, Einstein could not see that his equations and many variants of them could properly mesh with Newton’s theory. In mid 1913 he published a compromise: a sketch of a relativistic theory of gravitation that was not generally covariant. (For further details of these struggles, see Norton (1984).)
zh: 虽然爱因斯坦已默认撤回了对广义协变理论的反对，但他并未公开他认为空穴论证在何处失效。这一步他最终迈出，是他发表了 John Stachel 所谓的“点重合论证”（point-coincidence argument）之时。这个论证因爱因斯坦 (1916, p.117) 对其广义相对论的评述而广为人知，其实质是为莱布尼茨等价辩护。他力主：一个理论的物理内容由它所允许的时空重合的目录穷尽。例如，在一个只处理粒子的理论中，重合就是粒子世界线的交点。这些重合在场的变换下保持。因此，可以互相变换的两个场系统具有相同的物理内容；它们代表同一个物理系统。

en: His failure to find an admissible generally covariant theory troubled Einstein greatly. Later in 1913 he sought to transform his failure into a victory of sorts: he thought he could show that no generally covariant theory at all is admissible. Any such theory would violate what he called the Law of Causality—we would now call it determinism. He sought to demonstrate this remarkable claim with the hole argument.
zh: 多年间，空穴论证被当作一位洞若观火的爱因斯坦所犯的一个平凡错误。是 John Stachel (1980) 认出了它极不平凡的性质，并把这一认识带给现代物理学史与物理学哲学共同体。（另见 Stachel 1986。）在 Earman and Norton (1987) 中，该论证被重塑为明确针对时空实体论的论证。进一步的历史讨论见 Howard and Norton (1993)、Janssen (1999)、Klein (1995) 与 Norton (1987)。四卷本的全景式详尽论述是 Renn (2007)；关于空穴论证哲学复兴的历史，见 Weatherall (2020)。

en: In its original incarnation, Einstein considered a spacetime filled with matter excepting one region, the hole, which was matter-free. (So in this original form, the term “hole” makes more sense than in the modern version.) He then asked if a full specification of both metric and material fields outside the hole would fix the metric field within. Since he had tacitly eschewed Leibniz Equivalence, Einstein thought that the resulting negative answer sufficient to damn all generally covariant theories.
zh: 关于逻辑经验主义者对爱因斯坦点重合论证的挪用与误用，见 Giovanelli (2013)。

en: 8.2 …and Climbs out Again
zh: 9 对空穴论证的回应

en: Einstein struggled on for two years with his misshapen theory of limited covariance. Late in 1915, as evidence of his errors mounted inexorably, Einstein was driven to near despair and ultimately capitulation. He returned to the search for generally covariant equations with a new urgency, fueled in part by the knowledge that none other than David Hilbert had thrown himself into analysis of his theory. Einstein’s quest came to a happy close in late November 1915 with the completion of his theory in generally covariant form.
zh: 对空穴论证的回应，至少与写过它的作者一样多。本节对该文献做一次整理：自 1980 年代该论证在哲学文献中复兴以来，我们考察五大类回应。在对该论证的审视过程中，如今它的几乎所有方面都已被掂量与检验过。

en: For a long time it was thought that Hilbert had beaten Einstein by five days to the final theory. New evidence in the form of the proof pages of Hilbert’s paper now suggests he may not have. More importantly, it shows clearly that Hilbert, like Einstein, at least temporarily believed that the hole argument precluded all generally covariant theories and that the belief survived at least as far as the proof pages of his paper. (See Corry, Renn and Stachel 1997.)
zh: 9.1 否定实体论

en: While Einstein had tacitly withdrawn his objections to generally covariant theories, he had not made public where he thought the hole argument failed. This he finally did when he published what John Stachel calls the “point-coincidence argument.” This argument, well known from Einstein’s (1916, p.117) review of his general theory of relativity, amounts to a defence of Leibniz Equivalence. He urges that the physical content of a theory is exhausted by the catalog of the spacetime coincidences it licenses. For example, in a theory that treats particles only, the coincidences are the points of intersection of the particle worldlines. These coincidences are preserved by transformations of the fields. Therefore two systems of fields that can be intertransformed have the same physical content; they represent the same physical system.
zh: 一条思路径直同意：空穴论证使得接受莱布尼茨等价成为必然。它试图把这种接受所涉及的内容变得更透明，办法是寻找单一数学结构来表示一个物理时空系统，而不是莱布尼茨等价所允许的可互变换结构的等价类。其中一种尝试涉及“莱布尼茨代数”（Leibniz algebra）概念（见 Earman 1989, Ch. 9, Sect. 9）。这类尝试能否成功并不清楚。正如可互变换的场代表同一个物理系统，也存在着不同但可互变换、具有相同物理意涵的莱布尼茨代数。如果流形与莱布尼茨代数这两种形式体系可以互译，那么可以预期空穴论证也会在这种翻译下在后者中重现。（见 Rynasiewicz 1992。）

en: Over the years, the hole argument was deemed to be a trivial error by an otherwise insightful Einstein. It was John Stachel (1980) who recognized its highly non-trivial character and brought this realization to the modern community of historians and philosophers of physics. (See also Stachel, 1986.) In Earman and Norton (1987), the argument was recast as one that explicitly targets spacetime substantivalism. For further historical discussion, see Howard and Norton (1993), Janssen (1999), Klein (1995) and Norton (1987). A thorough, synoptic treatment in four volumes is Renn (2007); for a history of the philosophical revival of the hole argument, see Weatherall (2020).
zh: 另一种进路试图通过以“狄拉克可观测量”（Dirac observables）及相应的规范固定约定对时空点做个体化，来解释莱布尼茨等价并论证广义相对论与空穴论证的相容（Lusanna and Pauri 2006）。更一般地，我们很可以怀疑：时空实体论面临的困难是否是上文所述特定形式体系的假象。Bain (1998, 2003) 考察了转向其他形式体系（不限于莱布尼茨代数）的效果。

en: For an account of the appropriation and misappropriation of Einstein’s point-coincidence argument by the logical empiricists, see Giovanelli (2013).
zh: 9.2 接受非决定性

en: 9. Responses to the Hole Argument
zh: 对空穴论证的另一种回应是接受广义相对论等广义协变的时空理论是非决定论的。也许（照这种想法）这种非决定论并不可怕，因为它只是关于哪些对象例示哪些性质的非决定论，而不是关于例示了哪些性质样式的非决定论。然而，这是否足以化解对非决定论的担忧并不明显：至少，若另有回应可取，它们似乎更可取。

en: There are at least as many responses to the hole argument as authors who have written on it. In this section, we regiment the literature by considering five broad classes of response to the argument since it was revitalised in the philosophical literature of the 1980s. In the course of scrutinizing the argument, by now virtually all its aspects have been weighed and tested.
zh: 与此相关的一种回应是*重新定义*决定论，并论证：在相关意义上，尽管有空穴论证，广义相对论这类理论终究是决定论的。围绕空穴论证对决定论定义的修改已由 Belot (1995b)、Brighouse (1994, 2020)、Butterfield (1989)、Melia (1999) 与 Pooley (2021) 探讨。

en: 9.1 Reject substantivalism
zh: 9.3 度规本质主义

en: One line of thought simply agrees that the hole argument makes acceptance of Leibniz Equivalence compelling. It seeks to make more transparent what that acceptance involves by trying to find a single mathematical structure that represents a physical spacetime system rather than the equivalence class of intertransformable structures licensed by Leibniz Equivalence. One such attempt involves the notion of a “Leibniz algebra” (see Earman, 1989, Ch. 9, Sect. 9). It is unclear that such attempts can succeed. Just as intertransformable fields represent the same physical system, there are distinct but intertransformable Leibniz algebras with the same physical import. If the formalisms of manifolds and of Leibniz algebras are intertranslatable, one would expect the hole argument to reappear in the latter formalism as well under this translation. (See Rynasiewicz, 1992.)
zh: Maudlin (1990) 对空穴论证做出了极具原创性的回应：他主张每个时空事件本质地（essentially）携带其度规性质；也就是说，若（在场的重新分布之后）我们试图给它指派不同的度规性质，它就不再是那个事件了。这样一来，虽然对广义相对论（或所论的任何主动广义协变理论）的每一类可互变换解似乎都有一类不同的可能世界与之相联，事实上其中只有一个世界在形而上学上可能，于是空穴论证失效。Teitel (2019) 考察了这一本质主义回应的一个精细化版本，但结论是它并不优于对空穴论证的标准模态回应。Butterfield (1989) 把可互变换的系统刻画为不同的可能世界，并运用对应体理论（counterpart theory）论证至多只有一个能代表现实时空。（关于巴特菲尔德对应体论证的更新版本，见 Butterfield & Gomes 2023a, 2023b。）

en: Another approach seeks to explain Leibniz Equivalence and demonstrate the compatibility of general relativity with the hole argument through the individuation of spacetime points by means of “Dirac observables” and an associated gauge fixing stipulation (Lusanna and Pauri, 2006). More generally, we may well wonder whether the problems faced by spacetime substantivalism are artifacts of the particular formalism described above. Bain (1998, 2003) has explored the effect of a transition to other formalisms (including but not limited to Leibniz algebras).
zh: 9.4 精致实体论

en: 9.2 Accept the indeterminacy
zh: Maudlin 的度规本质主义是“精致实体论”（sophisticated substantivalism）的一例。这一术语由 Belot & Earman (2001) 以略带贬义的口吻引入，指这样一类观点：实体论者否认经洞变换相联系的系统代表不同的可能性终究是合法的，从而绕开空穴论证。精致实体论的另一版本是反此性（anti-haecceitist）实体论，按照它，物理时空点不拥有跨世界同一性。“宇宙的物质内容从现实世界的分布被移位”的那些世界之间的区别度，正以这类同一性为前提。于是，广义相对论及其他主动广义协变理论的表观非决定论，便通过否认这类同一性而得以避免。这一立场目前是对空穴论证的流行回应：讨论见 Hoefer (1996) 与 Pooley (2006b)；对该立场在形而上学上晦涩难明的担忧，见 Dasgupta (2011)。

en: An alternative response to the hole argument is to accept that generally covariant theories of space and time such as general relativity are indeterministic. Perhaps (the thought goes) this indeterminism is not troubling, because it is an indeterminism only about which objects instantiate which properties and not about which patterns of properties are instantiated. It is not obvious, however, that this is sufficient to defuse worries about indeterminism: at the very least, if another response to the argument were available, they would seem to be preferable.
zh: 精致实体论的另一相关版本主张：代表时空的与其说是单靠事件流形，不如说是某种更丰富的结构，例如事件流形连同度规性质。（例如见 Hoefer 1996。）这一逃逸路线的动机是：事件流形缺乏时空本质性的性质。例如，事件流形中没有过去与未来、时间流逝或空间距离的观念。于是人们可能忍不住把时空等同于事件流形*加上*供给这些时空观念的某个进一步结构。如此一来（照这种想法），以非刚性方式个体化时空点的正是度规结构。这条逃离空穴论证的路线有时成功，有时失败。在某些重要的特殊情形中，可以对该观点发动替代版本的空穴论证：见 Norton (1988)。

en: A related response here is to *redefine* determinism, and to argue that, in the relevant sense, theories such as general relativity are deterministic after all, in spite of the hole argument. Modifications to the definition of determinism in light of the hole argument have been explored by Belot (1995b), Brighouse (1994, 2020), Butterfield (1989), Melia (1999), and Pooley (2021).
zh: 9.5 数学/形式主义回应

en: 9.3 Metric essentialism
zh: 对空穴论证可能最简单的挑战是：莱布尼茨等价是现代数学物理文献中的标准预设，甚至考虑否定它都是不值得认真对待的数学错误。但可以这样回应：接受莱布尼茨等价在物理学文献中固然广泛，但它不是一条只能以自相矛盾为代价才能否定的*逻辑真理*。它承载着非平凡的假定，其意涵必须以清醒的反思加以接受——这一点由连大卫·希尔伯特本人都曾一度接受空穴论证所表明。（见上文 8.2 节。）如果否定莱布尼茨等价是一个连合格数学家都不会犯的低级错误，那么我们的合格标准已经高到不可企及，因为它必须把 1915 年鼎盛期的大卫·希尔伯特排除在外。

en: In his own highly original response to the hole argument, Maudlin (1990) urges that each spacetime event carries its metrical properties essentially; that is, it would not be that very event if (after redistribution of the fields) we tried to assign different metrical properties to it. As a result, although there appears to be a class of distinct possible worlds associated with each class of intertransformable solutions of general relativity (or whatever other actively generally covariant theory in which one is interested), in fact only one such world is metaphysically possible, and thereby the hole argument is vitiated. Teitel (2019) has explored a refined version of this essentialist response but concludes that it fails to improve on standard modal responses to the hole argument. Butterfield (1989) portrays intertransformable systems as different possible worlds and uses counterpart theory to argue that at most one can represent an actual spacetime. (For an updated version of Butterfield’s appeal to counterpart theory, see Butterfield & Gomes (2023a, 2023b).)
zh: 不过，这个问题近来被 Weatherall (2018) 重新揭开：他论证，可互变换的数学结构在标准数学实践中被当作同一结构，因此它们应当代表同一个物理系统，从而否定莱布尼茨等价被排除。Curiel (2018) 以不同依据论证了与 Weatherall 类似的平凡性结论：在标准物理实践中，洞变换没有*物理*对应物。对这类论证的回应、并为“这种‘数学结构主义’不足以封堵空穴论证”辩护的观点，见 Pooley & Read (2021)；同样地，Roberts (2020) 回应说：应当由自然——而非数学实践——来决定两个数学结构是否代表同一个物理系统。

en: 9.4 Sophisticated substantivalism
zh: 晚近，一些作者主张把数学基础从集合论正统加以修改就足以封堵空穴论证：在同伦类型理论的特定语境中对这类论证的讨论，见 Ladyman & Presnell (2020) 与 Dougherty (2020)。另外，Halvorson and Manchak (2021) 论证：由于存在唯一的保度规映射（“等距”）联系广义相对论中经洞变换相联系的两个解，空穴论证随之被封堵；对该论证的怀疑性回应，见 Menon & Read (2023)。

en: Maudlin’s metrical essentialism is an example of ‘sophisticated substantivalism’. This term was introduced—in a somewhat pejorative sense—by Belot & Earman (2001) to refer to a class of views according to which it is legitimate after all for a substantivalist to deny that systems related by hole transformation represent distinct possibilities, thereby side-stepping the hole argument. Another version of sophisticated substantivalism is anti-haecceitist substantivalism, according to which physical spacetime points do not possess trans-world identities. The distinctness of worlds in which the material content of the universe is shifted from its distribution in the actual world presupposes such identities. Thus the apparent indeterminism of general relativity and other actively generally covariant theories is avoided by denying such identities. This position is currently a popular response to the hole argument: for discussion e.g. Hoefer (1996) and Pooley (2006b); for some concerns that the position is metaphysically obscure, see Dasgupta (2011).
zh: Belot (2018) 反对对莱布尼茨等价作出单向的裁定。他一方面允许洞变换所联系的系统在物理上相同，另一方面论证：在广义相对论的某些区段，某些保持度规的变换可能联系物理上不同的系统。

en: Another related version of sophisticated substantivalism has it that spacetime is better represented not by the manifold of events alone but by some richer structure, such as the manifold of events in conjunction with metrical properties. (See, for example, Hoefer, 1996.) What motivates this escape is the idea that the manifold of events lacks properties essential to spacetime. For example, there is no notion of past and future, of time elapsed or of spatial distance in the manifold of events. Thus one might be tempted to identify spacetime with the manifold of events *plus* some further structure that supplies these spatiotemporal notions. Thereby, the thought might go, it is the metrical structure which individuates spacetime points non-rigidly. This escape from the hole argument sometimes succeeds and sometimes fails. In certain important special cases, alternative versions of the hole argument can be mounted against the view: see Norton (1988).
zh: 10 空穴论证的更广意义

en: 9.5 Mathematical/formalist responses
zh: 空穴论证在科学哲学中具有更广的意义，涉及对理论实体的实在论、量子引力理论，以及物理理论中的规范自由问题。本节讨论这三重关系；另有补充材料对第三点展开。

en: Perhaps the simplest possible challenge to the hole argument maintains that Leibniz Equivalence is a standard presumption in the modern mathematical physics literature and suggests that even entertaining its denial is a mathematical blunder unworthy of serious attention. But in response: while acceptance of Leibniz Equivalence is widespread in the physics literature, it is not a *logical truth* that can only be denied on pain of contradiction. That it embodies non-trivial assumptions whose import must be accepted with sober reflection is indicated by the early acceptance of the hole argument by none other than David Hilbert himself. (See Section 8.2 above.) If denial of Leibniz Equivalence is a blunder so egregious that no competent mathematician would make it, then our standards for competence have become unattainably high, for they must exclude David Hilbert in 1915 at the height of his powers.
zh: 10.1 科学实在论的界限

en: The question has nevertheless been reopened recently by Weatherall (2018), who aargues that intertransformable mathematical structures are taken in standard mathematical practice to be the same structure. Thus they should represent the same physical system, precluding the denial of Leibniz Equivalence. Curiel (2018) argues for a similar triviality conclusion as Weatherall but on a different basis: there is no *physical* correlate to the hole transformation in standard physical practice. For a response to arguments of this kind, defending the view that this kind of ‘mathematical structuralism’ is insufficient to block the hole argument, see Pooley & Read (2021); likewise, Roberts (2020) has responded that Nature—not mathematical practice—should decide whether two mathematical structures represent the same physical system.
zh: 空穴论证给科学实在论的兴起提出了一种新的障碍。按照那种观点，我们应当按字面解读成熟理论的断言。于是，如果广义相对论描述了一个事件流形与一个度规结构，那么在严格的科学实在论者看来，那里实实在在存在的就是这些。有人主张，不这样想就会让这些理论的成败沦为无法解释的奇迹。如果时空真的不具有广义相对论赋予它的几何结构，我们如何解释理论的成功？

en: Recently, some authors have argued that modifying the foundations of mathematics from the set-theoretic orthodoxy would be sufficient to block the hole argument: see Ladyman & Presnell (2020) and Dougherty (2020) for discussions of such arguments in the particular context of homotopy type theory. Separately, Halvorson and Manchak (2021) have argued that because there is a unique metric-preserving map (‘isometry’) relating two solutions of general relativity related by the hole transformation, the hole argument is thereby blocked; for sceptical responses to this argument, see Menon & Read (2023).
zh: 这个观点固然动人，但空穴论证表明：必须对我们对成功理论的字面解读施加某些限制。或者至少说，坚持这种字面解读要付出高昂代价。空穴论证让我们看到，我们可能不得不承认，实际存在的东西比字面解读所说的要少一点，免得我们被迫设定一些既超越观察、又超越理论决定能力的物理实在性质。

en: Belot (2018) argues against a single decision univocally in favor or contrary to Leibniz Equivalence. While allowing that hole transformations relate systems that are physically the same, he argues that in some sectors of general relativity, some transformations that preserve the metric may relate physically distinct systems.
zh: 10.2 空穴论证与引力的量子化

en: 10. Broader Significance of the Hole Argument
zh: 现代理论物理学最顽固的难题之一是引力的量子化。爱因斯坦 1915 年的广义相对论以时空曲率来思考引力，带来了一场革命；但如今人们普遍同意，它不可能是引力的最终说明。原因在于：它仍是一个经典理论。它不按量子理论处理物质。

en: The hole argument has had a broader significance in the philosophy of science, pertaining *inter alia *to realism about theoretical entities, to theories of quantum gravity, and to the issue of gauge freedoms in our physical theories. We discuss all three of these relations in this section; there is also a supplementary document which expands upon the third.
zh: 把量子理论与广义相对论纳入单一理论的问题仍未解决。（见“量子引力”词条。）竞争者众多，著名的有弦论与圈量子引力。有人提出的问题是：空穴论证向我们表明（照这种主张），任何成功的量子引力理论都不能设定一个独立的、作为容器的时空。John Stachel 是空穴论证这一结论的早期支持者，见 Stachel (2006)。圈量子引力论者常常专门以此批评弦论进路，因为弦论进路有这样一个背景时空。见 Rovelli and Gaul (2000) 与 Smolin (2006)；关于这些“背景独立”问题的哲学讨论，见 Pooley (2017) 与 Read (2023)。

en: 10.1 A Limit to Scientific Realism
zh: 在一个相关进展中，Gryb and Thébault (2016) 论证：在适当假定下，空穴论证问题与量子引力的“时间问题”本质上是同一个问题。更多讨论见“量子引力”词条中的“时间问题”。

en: The hole argument has presented a new sort of obstacle to the rise of scientific realism. According to that view, we should read the assertions of our mature theories literally. So, if general relativity describes a manifold of events and a metrical structure, then that is literally what is there in the view of the strict scientific realist. To think otherwise, it is asserted, would be to leave the success of these theories an unexplained miracle. If spacetime does not really have the geometrical structure attributed to it by general relativity, then how can we explain the theory’s success?
zh: 10.3 空穴论证与规范自由

en: Appealing as this view is, the hole argument shows that some limits must be placed on our literal reading of a successful theory. Or at least that persistence in such literal readings comes with a high price. The hole argument shows us that we might want to admit that there is something a little less really there than the literal reading says, lest we be forced to posit physically real properties that transcend both observation and the determining power of our theory.
zh: 物理学哲学日益认识到规范变换（gauge transformations）的重要性：它们作用于我们物理理论中的某些自由度，而这些自由度被认为在物理实在中没有对应物。空穴论证的分析为物理学哲学家提供了一个便利的模板，供他们判断某物是否为规范自由。如导言所述，我们从空穴论证中学到：多余数学结构的认定无法靠任何先验或纯数学的规则达成（至少在假定上文讨论的数学/形式主义回应不成立的前提下）。而需要某些物理依据。空穴论证提供了两条可用的依据：（i）可证实性——候选多余结构的变化不会对可被观察证实的东西造成任何差别；（ii）决定论——理论的定律无法固定该候选多余结构。关于空穴论证与规范自由的更详细讨论，见补充材料[作为分析规范自由之模板的空穴论证](spacetime-holearg.gauge.md)。

en: 10.2 The Hole Argument and the Quantization of Gravity
zh: 脚注

en: One of the most tenacious problems in modern theoretical physics is the quantization of gravity. While Einstein’s 1915 general theory of relativity produced a revolutionary new way of thinking of gravitation in terms of the curvature of spacetime, it is generally agreed now that it cannot be the final account of gravity. The reason is that it is still a classical theory. It does not treat matter in accord with the quantum theory.
zh: [^note-1]: 该论证的形式沿袭 Earman and Norton (1987) 最初给出的版本。关于空穴论证在介于本文正文与这些脚注之间的技术层次上的展开，见 Norton (1992a, Section 5.12)。

en: The problem of bringing quantum theory and general relativity together in a single theory remains unsolved. (See Quantum Gravity.) There are many contenders, notably string theory and loop quantum gravity. One of the issues that has been raised is that the hole argument has shown us (so goes the claim) that no successful theory of quantum gravity can be set against an independent, container spacetime. John Stachel was an early proponent of this outcome of the hole argument. See Stachel (2006). This issue has often been raised by loop quantum gravity theorists specifically as a criticism of string theoretic approaches, for string theoretic approaches have such a background spacetime. See Rovelli and Gaul (2000) and Smolin (2006); for philosophical engagement with these issues of “background independence”, see Pooley (2017) and Read (2023).
zh: 一般而言，空穴论证所发动的理论类是“局域时空理论”。这些理论的模型由 $n+1$ 元组

en: In a related development, Gryb and Thébault (2016) have argued that the problem of the hole argument and the “problem of time” of quantum gravity are essentially the same, given suitable assumptions. For more, see Problem of Time in the article on quantum gravity.
zh: $$ (M, O_1 , \ldots ,O_n) $$

en: 10.3 The Hole Argument and Gauge Freedoms
zh: 构成，其中 $O_1 , \ldots ,O_n$ 是定义在微分流形 $M$ 上的几何对象场。理论中的模型类由某组不变（如张量）方程划界，它们就是理论的定律：

en: The hole argument has played a role in the growing recognition in philosophy of physics of the importance of gauge transformations: transformations acting on certain degrees of freedom in our physical theories which are supposed to have no correlates in physical reality. The analysis of the hole argument provides philosophers of physics with a convenient template when they are trying to decide whether or not something is a gauge freedom. As mentioned in the introduction, we learn from the hole argument that the identification of surplus mathematical structure cannot be achieved by any a priori or purely mathematical rule (at least on the assumption that the mathematical/formalist responses to the hole argument discussed above do not succeed). Rather, some physical grounds are needed. The hole argument provides two grounds that can be used: (i) verifiability—changes in the candidate surplus structure make no difference to what can be verified in observation; and (ii) determinism—the laws of the theory are unable to fix the candidate surplus structure. For more detailed discussion on the hole argument and gauge freedoms, see the supplement [The Hole Argument as a Template for Analyzing Gauge Freedoms](spacetime-holearg.gauge.md).
References（引用注释）
zh: 其中诸量 $L_i$ 是几何对象 $O_i$ 的函数。理论被假定是完备的，即任何满足这些定律的模型都在该理论的模型集中。对局域时空理论的这一刻画足够一般，足以涵盖几乎所有常见时空理论的表述，包括广义相对论、狭义相对论与牛顿理论。

en: In general, the class of theories in which the hole argument is mounted are “local spacetime theories.” These are theories whose models consist of $n+1$ tuples
zh: $$\begin{align} \mathbf{B} &= \boldsymbol{\nabla} \times \mathbf{A} \\ \mathbf{E} &= -\boldsymbol{\nabla} \phi - \partial \mathbf{A}/\partial t \end{align}$$

en: $$ (M, O_1 , \ldots ,O_n) $$
zh: 由此可知 $\mathbf{B}$ 与 $\mathbf{E}$ 在下述规范变换下不变：

en: where the $O_1 , \ldots ,O_n$ are geometric object fields defined on a differential manifold $M$. The class of models in the theory is delimited by some set of invariant (e.g. tensorial) equations, which are the laws of the theory:
zh: $$\begin{align} \mathbf{A}' &= \mathbf{A} - \boldsymbol{\nabla} \lambda \\ \phi' &= \phi + \partial \lambda /\partial t \end{align}$$
该规范变换由标量场 $\lambda$ 生成，$\lambda$ 可以是空间与时间的任意函数。为制造洞型变换，我们选取一个除某个足够小的时空区域外处处为零、而在该区域内平滑地偏离零的 $\lambda$。所得的两组势 $(\phi , \mathbf{A})$ 与 $(\phi ', \mathbf{A}')$ 在洞外处处一致，但在洞内平滑地产生差别。

en: where the quantities $L_i$ are functions of the geometric objects $O_i$. The theory is presumed complete in the sense that any model satisfying these laws will be in the model set of the theory. This characterization of local spacetime theories is sufficiently general to include formulations of virtually all common spacetime theories, including general relativity, special relativity and Newtonian theories.
zh: 与前文一样，任何想把这两组势之间的差别说成某种物理实在之物的企图，都面临同样的问题。这些差别不表达在任何可观察的东西中。一切可观测量都由场强 $\mathbf{E}$ 与 $\mathbf{B}$ 导出，而两组势在 $\mathbf{E}$ 与 $\mathbf{B}$ 上一致。进一步，麦克斯韦方程组也无法在两组势之间做出选择：因为麦克斯韦方程组完全由这同一组 $\mathbf{E}$ 与 $\mathbf{B}$ 场表达。

en: [^note-2]: In brief, the distinction between the passive and active general covariance is as follows. Passive general covariance allows use of all coordinate charts of the differential manifold and is conferred automatically on theories formulated by modern methods. Active general covariance considers the dual point transformations induced by coordinate transformations. These amount to diffeomorphisms on the manifold $M$ and the transformations of the fields correspond to maps that associate an object field $O$ with its carry along $h^* O$ under diffeomorphism $h$.
zh: 参考文献

en: The need to convert Einstein’s original analysis from passive to active transformations is awkward. The distinction between them was not so clear cut when Einstein originally formulated the hole argument because of the more impoverished mathematical environment in which he worked and that this is responsible for much of the present confusion in interpreting Einstein’s pronouncements on coordinate systems. See Norton (1989, 1992). For some recent discussion of the difference between passive and active transformations, see Pooley (2017).
